supportingSources.label: Pinball News The Avengers rules and playfield guide

strategy.summary: Spell L-O-K-I in the bottom lanes and lock two balls at the right ramp. Shoot the right inner orbit four times to start Iron Man, then collect the third right-ramp lock so Iron Man continues during Loki Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Iron Man
quickInfo.summary: Four shots to the right inner orbit start Iron Man. Seven more right-inner-orbit shots spell I-R-O-N-M-A-N and complete the mode.

quickInfo.name: Loki Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Spell L-O-K-I through the bottom lanes, then lock three balls at the right ramp. The third lock starts Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Hulk Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the H-U-L-K drop bank three times, then shoot the Hulk saucer, Hulk, or a lit Hulk Multiball arrow to start.

quickInfo.name: Tesseract
quickInfo.summary: Spin the cube to spell C-O-S-M-I-C and start Tesseract Scoring. Tesseract can run during either primary Multiball.

steps.text: Use lane change to spell L-O-K-I in the bottom lanes and light all three Loki locks.
Shoot the right ramp twice to lock two balls for Loki Multiball.
Shoot the right inner orbit four times to start Iron Man.
Shoot the right ramp for the third lock. This starts Loki Multiball while Iron Man is running.
Repeat the right inner orbit to spell I-R-O-N-M-A-N while collecting Loki Jackpots at Hawkeye, Black Widow, and Iron Man.
After those three Jackpot pairs, hit Hulk twice, then Captain America twice, and shoot the strobing Loki lock for the Super Jackpot.

fallback.title: Recovery: Hulk Multiball
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the bottom lanes or right-ramp locks are not progressing.

steps.text: Complete the H-U-L-K drop bank three times.
Shoot the Hulk saucer, Hulk, or a lit Hulk Multiball arrow to start four-ball Hulk Multiball.
Knock down the three standing H-U-L-K targets for Jackpots, then hit Hulk four times.
Hit each flashing H-U-L-K target once, then shoot Hulk Smash for the Super Jackpot.
Complete each Avenger's named-shot sequence; starting Hulk Multiball collects Hulk.
When all six sectors on the progress display are lit, shoot the strobing Loki lock to start Assault on the Helicarrier.

techniques.name: LOKI lane change
techniques.instruction: Tap the flippers before lower-lane entries to move the needed LOKI letter into the ball's path.

checkBeforePlay: Note the lock and ball-save settings.
Test the Hulk bank, Loki ramp, and Tesseract.
strategy.simpleOverview: The Avengers builds each Avenger at that character's named shot. Spell L-O-K-I in the bottom lanes and lock two balls at the right ramp, then shoot the right inner orbit four times to start Iron Man. Collect the third right-ramp lock so Iron Man continues during Loki Multiball.
strategy.overview: The Avengers builds six Avenger modes at their named shots, and a running mode can continue into the Hulk and Loki Multiballs. Spell L-O-K-I in the bottom lanes and lock two balls at the right ramp, then shoot the right inner orbit four times to start Iron Man. Collect the third right-ramp lock and finish Iron Man during Loki Multiball.
